scope_rationale: The existing T11 arithmetic-helper selection leaf is refined with an actual variable-count first-principles implementation; fixed128-bit support is not equivalent.

competencies.outcome: Derive canonical runtime-length radix representation, carry/borrow and exact multiplication accumulator bounds; implement transactional magnitude arithmetic and quotient/remainder.
Implement signed truncating division and an owned capacity adapter; prove old borrows survive failed allocation and expire only after successful replacement.
Audit actual generated target objects and linked images at both radices/optimizations; distinguish implementation support, emitted helpers and hosted verification dependencies.
Falsify six distinct defects with independent arbitrary-size arithmetic and refusal snapshots; transfer16-to8-bit limbs and caller storage to signed owning growth with explicit evidence limits.
